g.text: Network Devices Hierarchy across OSI Layers
Classification of repeaters, switches, routers, and gateways: data unit, addressing, and collision/broadcast isolation.
e.g., SIP VoIP to SS7/PSTN, HTTP/REST to SOAP or SNA mainframe
PDU: Packets | Addressing: Logical IP (IPv4 / IPv6)
Lookup: Routing Table / FIB (Forwarding Info Base), Longest Prefix Match
Decrements TTL, recalculates L3 checksum, strips & rebuilds L2 MAC header
Fallback: Transparently bridges non-routable protocols (NetBEUI, LAT)
Prevents traffic drop when non-routable legacy frames traverse routed WANs
CAM Table: Auto-learns source MACs, unicasts known destinations
Microsegmentation: Dedicated line-rate bandwidth per port; full duplex eliminates collisions
PDU: Raw Bits | Addressing: None (No MAC / No IP recognition)
Operation: Blind electrical amplification & signal regeneration
Floods bits out ALL ports simultaneously; half-duplex only; CSMA/CD mandatory
COLLISION DOMAIN VS. BROADCAST DOMAIN QUICK REFERENCE
